name: Boosting Female Founders Initiative — Round 1 (AU, GO3792)
source: Department of Industry, Science and Resources — GrantConnect GO3792 (trích nguyên văn từ tài liệu phân tích khách cung cấp 2026-09-07). Nhóm quỹ: Cross-industry. Bẫy đặc thù: majority (≥51%) female owned and led.

rules.title_vi: Startup do nữ giới SỞ HỮU VÀ LÃNH ĐẠO ĐA SỐ (>50%)
rules.quote: To be eligible you must: be a female founded (majority owned and led by women) startup; show evidence that your startup is a female founded (majority owned and led by women)
be registered for the Goods and Services Tax (GST)

be one of the following entities: an entity incorporated in Australia; an incorporated trustee on behalf of a trust; an Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Corporation registered under the Corporations (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander) Act 2006 (Cth); a partnership; a sole trader.

rules.title_vi: Không thuộc diện loại trừ (miễn thuế TNDN, unincorporated, trust, cơ quan nhà nước)
rules.quote: You are not eligible to apply if you are: income tax exempt; an unincorporated association; a trust (however, an incorporated trustee may apply on behalf of a trust); a Commonwealth, State, Territory or local government body (including government business enterprises)

rules.title_vi: Mức grant $25.000–$480.000, tối đa 50% chi phí hợp lệ
rules.quote: Estimated Grant Value (AUD): From $25,000.00 to $480,000.00. The grant amount will be up to 50 per cent of eligible project costs
